item.description:
⚡ A Copilot business seat shows its quota again, and there is now a Diagnostics window for when a figure will not read.

✨ New

  • 🩺 Diagnostics, in Preferences under App: what each provider actually answered, ready to copy into a bug report. It takes about a minute — Claude Code's panel is slow to draw — and it carries no account id, no file paths, and nothing about the projects or skills you work on.

🔧 Fixed

  • 💳 A Copilot seat metered in premium requests reads its quota again. The row had been saying it could not read Copilot's usage panel while the real figure sat in the reply, unread.
  • 🧹 Every button in Preferences answers the pointer now, and each bare icon says what it does.

💬 Tell me what breaks: https://tokenpacer.com/#feedback
